title: Everything's+Amazing+ +Nobody's+Happy
summary: A short clip of Louis C.K.'s Conan interview riff 'Everything's Amazing and Nobody's Happy', about how people take modern technology for granted and complain about marvels.
why: HN uses it as a reference when commenters want to point out how quickly people forget the wonder of modern technology and complain anyway.

quote.text: Few people seem to recognize how much of an accomplishment this is
